definitions.explanation: Light-colored, mildly sweet miso made with a high ratio of rice koji and a short fermentation period. Associated with Kyoto and Western Japan; the standard miso for ozōni in those regions.

examples.japanese: {白味噌|しろみそ}の{味噌汁|みそしる}は{甘|あま}い。
examples.english: Miso soup made with white miso is sweet.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}の{雑煮|ぞうに}は{白味噌|しろみそ}{仕立|じた}てが{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Kyoto-style ozoni is basically made with white miso.

examples.japanese: {白味噌|しろみそ}は{熟成期間|じゅくせいきかん}が{短|みじか}いので{保存|ほぞん}があまり{利|き}かない。
examples.english: Because white miso has a short fermentation period, it doesn't keep very well.

notes:
Compound of {白|しろ} (white) + {味噌|みそ} (miso). Contrasts with {赤味噌|あかみそ} (red miso) and {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ} (mixed miso).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白味噌|しろみそ}{仕立|じた}て: prepared with white miso (esp. of soup)
- {白味噌|しろみそ}の{味噌汁|みそしる}: miso soup with white miso
- {京|きょう}{白味噌|しろみそ}: Kyoto white miso
- {白味噌|しろみそ}{雑煮|ぞうに}: white-miso ozoni (New Year's soup)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {赤味噌|あかみそ}: red miso — darker, saltier, longer fermentation
- {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}: blended miso — mix of white and red
- {麦|むぎ}{味噌|みそ}: barley miso — common in Kyushu
